trials.claim: 40 icon credits per month with monthly refill
trials.claimQuote: 40 icon credits per month (refills every month)
trials.reasoning: A buyer confirms Tier 1 includes a monthly allowance of 40 credits. The prosecution reviews show credits can be spent quickly, but they do not dispute that 40 credits are provided or refilled monthly.

exhibits.quote: Five brand icons in a couple of different styles quickly spent over 100 credits.
exhibits.argument: Five icons can consume over 100 credits, so 40 credits per month does not cover normal use.

exhibits.quote: When selecting multiple styles, the limits quickly get exhausted.
exhibits.argument: Selecting multiple styles exhausts limits quickly, undermining the value of a 40-credit monthly refill.

exhibits.quote: I was wondering if the monthly allowance of 40 credits would be sufficient for creating the icons I wanted for Tier 1.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms Tier 1 includes a monthly allowance of 40 credits.

trials.claim: 80 icon credits per month with monthly refill
trials.claimQuote: 80 icon credits per month (refills every month)
trials.reasoning: No exhibit confirms an 80-credit monthly allowance or refill. The prosecution reviews show heavy credit use and one failed delivery, but neither proves the stated 80-credit amount is false.

exhibits.quote: Five brand icons in a couple of different styles quickly spent over 100 credits.
exhibits.argument: Five icons can consume over 100 credits, so 80 credits per month does not cover normal use.

exhibits.quote: 26 additional credits were deducted, but no icons appeared on the page, the icon gallery, or the email.
exhibits.argument: Credits are deducted without delivering icons, so the stated monthly credits do not equal usable icons.

trials.claim: Create app icons with AI in 3 steps
trials.claimQuote: Create your own app icons with AI in 3 easy steps
trials.reasoning: Two reviews materially limit the 3-easy-steps claim, reporting icons with artifacts needing extra editing and generations that produced the wrong subject. This outweighs the vendor's own marketing restatement and one positive review.

exhibits.quote: Most of the icons generated by this product are unsuitable for use without additional image editing because of strange artifacts that appear on many of the images.
exhibits.argument: Icons require additional image editing, so creation is not finished in 3 easy steps.

exhibits.quote: I wanted an icon of a courtyard gate, but instead my generation produced three houses and a church.
exhibits.argument: The AI failed to produce the requested object, contradicting easy 3-step creation.

exhibits.quote: Create your own app icons from text in 3 easy steps
exhibits.argument: The vendor's homepage states the same 3-step AI app icon creation claim.

exhibits.quote: You can quickly create high-quality icons for mobile or web applications, including favicons, etc.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the tool quickly creates high-quality icons as promised.
